name: Ikhor
desc: A fragment of the Proto-Man's power, for which the Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka, Pavlina, created a body out of the Primal Ice. The body was destroyed by Pavlina in an attempt to imbue Snegovik with a soul.

customize.name: Proto-Man
customize.desc: The Key, created as a result of countless experiments, was supposed to help the Belyi Tsar become the Primordial Human.

customize.text: After the Proto-Man was divided into three parts, a third of his power became Ikhor.

customize.name: Pavlina
customize.desc: Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka from the House of Hesperides.

customize.text: The princess of the Snegurochka tried to use this fragment to imbue all Snegovik with a soul through a ritual. She created a body from the Primal Ice for Ikhor and gradually absorbed the power of the Proto-Man in an endless wedding in the House of Hesperides.

customize.name: Belyi Tsar
customize.desc: Monomakh Snezhnyi was the Tsar of all Fae and the first Cryo Archon.

customize.text: Ikhor has the appearance of the Belyi Tsar in human form during his youth.

customize.name: Severed Fragment of Ikhor
customize.desc:
A fragment of Ikhor's power, split off by Aksinya when the "ritual" was interrupted.
For some reason, it has taken the form of a glowing doll. Perhaps the desire to "fulfill the wishes of others" became the strings that controlled him long ago, and now he is nothing more than a puppet carrying a form of transcendent power.
